#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Handcrafted semantic cases compared against the brute-force reference."""
import json, subprocess, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev')
import exact_ref as R
import fuzz as F

def core_info(doc):
    ixps=set(doc['ixps'])
    agg={}
    for rec in doc['rib']:
        p,looped=R.normalize(rec['path'], ixps)
        if looped or len(p)<2: continue
        agg[p]=agg.get(p,0)+rec['count']
    links=set()
    for p in agg:
        for i in range(len(p)-1): links.add(R.canon(p[i],p[i+1]))
    rounds, finals=R.peel(agg)
    core=sorted(links-set(rounds))
    occ=R.occurrences(finals, core) if core else []
    return core, R.scopes_of(core, occ)

def run(name, doc, want_order=True, expect_invalid=False):
    core, scopes = core_info(doc)
    if len(core) > 8:
        print('SKIP (too many core links for brute force)', name); return
    perm = F.find_order(scopes, len(core))
    if perm is None:
        perm_order = [[core[i][0], core[i][1]] for i in range(len(core))] if want_order!='valid' else None
        if perm is None and want_order == 'valid':
            print('SKIP (no narrow order)', name); return
    doc = json.loads(json.dumps(doc))
    if want_order == 'valid':
        if perm is None:
            print('FAIL', name, 'no valid order found'); return
        doc['order']=[[core[i][0], core[i][1]] for i in perm]
    elif want_order == 'wide':
        # deliberately use an order with width > 4 if it exists
        doc['order']=[[c[0],c[1]] for c in core]
    res = R.reference(doc)
    expected = ({'error':'invalid'} if expect_invalid else ({'error':'zero-partition'} if 'error' in res else R.floats(res)))
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','/workspace/submission/main.py'],input=json.dumps(doc).encode(),capture_output=True)
    got=json.loads(p.stdout)
    ok = F.same(expected, got) if not expect_invalid else (got=={'error':'invalid'})
    print(('PASS ' if ok else 'FAIL ')+name)
    if not ok:
        print('  doc ', json.dumps(doc))
        print('  want', json.dumps(expected)[:900])
        print('  got ', json.dumps(got)[:900])

def D(rib, ixps=None, priors=None, declared=None, queries=None):
    return {'version':1,'ixps':ixps or [],'rib':rib,'priors':priors or [],'declared':declared or [],'order':[],'queries':queries or []}

Q=lambda i,p,t: {'id':i,'path':p,'threshold':t}
